checks.name: ck_auth_principal_identity
checks.sqltext: kind::text = 'agent'::text AND agent_id IS NOT NULL AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM agent_id)) > 0 AND actor_role IS NOT NULL AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM actor_role)) > 0 AND username IS NULL AND password_hash IS NULL OR kind::text = 'human'::text AND agent_id IS NULL AND actor_role IS NULL AND username IS NOT NULL AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM username)) > 0 AND password_hash IS NOT NULL AND password_hash::text ~~ '$argon2id$%%'::text

checks.name: ck_auth_principal_kind
checks.sqltext: (kind::text = ANY (ARRAY['agent'::character varying, 'human'::character varying]::text[])) AND auth_version >= 1 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM principal_id)) > 0

checks.name: ck_auth_principal_permissions
checks.sqltext: jsonb_typeof(permissions) = 'array'::text AND (kind::text = 'agent'::text AND permissions <@ '["actions:evaluate", "actions:execute", "actions:rollback", "records:read_own"]'::jsonb OR kind::text = 'human'::text AND permissions <@ '["agents:promote", "escalations:prepare", "escalations:review", "evidence:read", "policies:promote"]'::jsonb)

checks.name: ck_decision_outcome
checks.sqltext: outcome::text = ANY (ARRAY['ALLOWED'::character varying, 'DENIED'::character varying, 'ESCALATED'::character varying, 'PENDING_APPROVAL'::character varying, 'SHADOW_LOGGED'::character varying]::text[])

checks.name: ck_decision_risk_level
checks.sqltext: risk_level::text = ANY (ARRAY['READ_ONLY'::character varying, 'LOW'::character varying, 'MEDIUM'::character varying, 'HIGH'::character varying, 'CRITICAL'::character varying]::text[])

checks.name: ck_workflow_background_schedule
checks.sqltext: execution_mode::text = 'sync'::text OR input_envelope IS NOT NULL AND caller_principal_id IS NOT NULL AND (status::text = 'PROCESSING'::text AND run_deadline IS NOT NULL AND heartbeat_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_until <= run_deadline AND queue_deadline IS NULL AND next_run_at IS NULL OR status::text <> 'PROCESSING'::text AND owner IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL AND run_deadline IS NULL AND heartbeat_at IS NULL AND (status::text = 'QUEUED'::text AND queue_deadline IS NOT NULL AND next_run_at IS NULL OR status::text = 'RETRY_WAIT'::text AND queue_deadline IS NULL AND next_run_at IS NOT NULL OR (status::text = ANY (ARRAY['COMPLETED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying]::text[])) AND queue_deadline IS NULL AND next_run_at IS NULL))

checks.name: ck_workflow_identity
checks.sqltext: length(TRIM(BOTH FROM kind)) > 0 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM scope)) > 0 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM idempotency_key)) >= 1 AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM idempotency_key)) <= 200 AND length(input_hash::text) = 64

checks.name: ck_workflow_owner_stage
checks.sqltext: length(TRIM(BOTH FROM stage)) > 0 AND (owner IS NULL OR length(TRIM(BOTH FROM owner)) > 0)

checks.name: ck_workflow_result
checks.sqltext: status::text = 'QUEUED'::text AND execution_mode::text = 'background'::text AND input_envelope IS NOT NULL AND response IS NULL AND error IS NULL AND owner IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL AND retryable = false OR status::text = 'RETRY_WAIT'::text AND execution_mode::text = 'background'::text AND input_envelope IS NOT NULL AND response IS NULL AND error IS NOT NULL AND owner IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL AND retryable = true OR status::text = 'PROCESSING'::text AND response IS NULL AND error IS NULL AND retryable = false AND owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL OR status::text = 'COMPLETED'::text AND response IS NOT NULL AND error IS NULL AND retryable = false OR status::text = 'FAILED'::text AND response IS NULL AND error IS NOT NULL

checks.name: ck_workflow_status
checks.sqltext: status::text = ANY (ARRAY['QUEUED'::character varying, 'RETRY_WAIT'::character varying, 'PROCESSING'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying]::text[])

regex_deny_rules.reason: environment file may contain live secrets
